name: gameobject-duplicate
description: Duplicates a GameObject hierarchy/subtree as sibling or under parentPath/parentInstanceId.

instanceId.description: Source GameObject instance id to duplicate.

parentPath.description: Optional destination parent path. Omit to duplicate as a sibling; null duplicates at scene/prefab-stage root.

parentInstanceId.description: Optional destination parent instance id. Omit to duplicate as a sibling; null duplicates at scene/prefab-stage root.

includeChildren.description: When true (default), duplicate the full child hierarchy/subtree. When false, duplicate only the root GameObject and components.

count.description: Number of duplicates to create. Defaults to 1. Allowed range: 1..100.

position.description: Optional local position for each duplicate. Mutually exclusive with positionOffset.

positionOffset.description: Optional local position offset applied per duplicate index. Mutually exclusive with position.

rotationEuler.description: Optional local Euler rotation for each duplicate. Mutually exclusive with rotationEulerOffset/euler/eulerOffset.

rotationEulerOffset.description: Optional local Euler offset applied per duplicate index. Mutually exclusive with rotationEuler/euler/eulerOffset.

scale.description: Optional local scale for each duplicate. Mutually exclusive with scaleOffset.

scaleOffset.description: Optional local scale offset applied per duplicate index. Mutually exclusive with scale.
